reviews.title: Great inexpensive fans
reviews.comment: Great fans. Provides good air flow, quiet and looks fantastic. They were inexpensive and I would recommend.
reviews.author: Richard J. Ehart

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.comment: Very easy to set up, more companies need to use the modular design like these. Great anti vibration padding for mounting. Very quiet fans that push a lot of air. I have ordered two sets because of how good they are for the price.
reviews.author: Israel

reviews.title: Amazing Case Fans
reviews.comment: These fans are absolutely beautiful. They are quiet even under high load. They pull/push a ton of air as well. LEDs are plenty bright and not overkill with plenty of cable length to connect them to fit your need. Highly recommend these fan.
reviews.author: Spidygoat

reviews.title: Decent budget pick and clean geometric aesthetic
reviews.comment: 10000% love the style. Theyve got this geometric and more low-key style that I really prefer compared to the usual unicorn vomit covering as much of the fans as possible. Absolutely worth the price, pretty competitive to several other budget fans. Noise levels were great at first but I think I needed the levels or wiring cause now the constantly run at max which is pretty loud but not enough to distract me. Overall doesn't feel like the Greatest quality but plastic still feels more rugged than expected. The built in linking does make it very nice and easy to install on the case. So far they do a great job keeping my components cool I haven't seen any part go past 75C
reviews.author: Mark Ledesma
